file_insights.changes_summary: Refactored material_list view to use apply_list_filters utility instead of manual filter implementation
key_changes: Added import for FilterConfig and apply_list_filters from apps.core.list_utils
Replaced manual filter logic with declarative FilterConfig objects
Centralized pagination and filtering through apply_list_filters utility function
Updated context construction to use result dictionary from utility

patterns_discovered.description: Views define filters declaratively using FilterConfig objects with param_name, filter_type, and filter_kwargs
patterns_discovered.benefit: Reduces code duplication and makes filter logic more maintainable and consistent across views

patterns_discovered.description: The apply_list_filters utility centralizes pagination, filtering, and ordering logic
patterns_discovered.benefit: Single source of truth for list view behavior across the application

patterns_discovered.description: Search filters specify which fields to search via search_fields parameter
patterns_discovered.benefit: Allows flexible multi-field search without hardcoding Q objects in views

gotchas_discovered.gotcha: Context value extraction from utility result
gotchas_discovered.description: Context values must be extracted from the result dictionary returned by apply_list_filters (e.g., result['filter_values']['search'])
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Clearly document the structure of the result dictionary returned by apply_list_filters

gotchas_discovered.description: Category ID requires explicit int() conversion when building context, even though it comes from the utility
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Handle type conversion consistently, potentially within the utility or document when views need to apply it

gotchas_discovered.description: The filter_kwargs dictionary uses '{value}' placeholder that is replaced at runtime with actual filter values
gotchas_discovered.mitigation: Ensure this templating behavior is clearly documented and consistently applied across all views using FilterConfig

approach_outcome.description: Successfully refactored the material_list view to use the apply_list_filters utility, reducing code complexity and improving maintainability

metrics.complexity_reduction: Manual filter chains replaced with declarative configuration

recommendations.recommendation: Document the apply_list_filters return value structure
recommendations.rationale: Multiple views need to extract values from the result dictionary; clear documentation prevents errors

recommendations.recommendation: Standardize type conversion for filter values
recommendations.rationale: Current approach requires views to handle type conversion (int() for category_id); consider centralizing this

recommendations.recommendation: Create FilterConfig builder or factory methods
recommendations.rationale: Would reduce boilerplate when defining similar filters across multiple views
Ensure placeholder syntax in filter_kwargs is correct and all required parameters are present

recommendations.recommendation: Consider extracting prefetch_related and select_related into QuerySet optimization configuration
recommendations.rationale: Could further consolidate query optimization logic alongside filtering configuration
